[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] [[Sacnoth Valley]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear Sacnoth Valley in the [[Charr Homelands]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 5,000 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 250 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
